name: @hraness/support-foundation
description: Offer free product updates and optional paid support from a CLI, with a shared weekly cooldown and opt-out.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/node.ts --target node --format esm --outdir dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --workspace --all-targets && cargo build --locked --example interop
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run check:rust-contract && bun run check:rust && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:package
